title: A compressed wave
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Blueshift means a shift toward shorter wavelengths. It can arise when a source and observer approach each other; not every galaxy is receding locally.

objective: Use the visual model to reason about: A spectral line is observed at a shorter wavelength than it was emitted. What is this change called?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: A spectral line is observed at a shorter wavelength than it was emitted. What is this change called? Blueshift. Blueshift means a shift toward shorter wavelengths. It can arise when a source and observer approach each other; not every galaxy is receding locally.
